values.description: Balance of one or more items charged back to seller.

values.name: Offset
values.description: Allocation of one or more debit items to one or more credit items or vice-versa.

values.name: Indirect payment
values.description: Payment in settlement of an invoice has been made to a party other than the designated creditor.

values.name: Financial reassignment
values.description: Previously assigned invoice/credit note is being reassigned.

values.description: Reversal or cancellation of a chargeback and/or offset relating to an incorrect balance.

values.description: Buyer expects that seller revises the terms of payment of an invoice.

values.description: Invoice has been/to be paid to seller's agent.
